items.title: Draymond Green swats back at online critics, fuels Warriors' win over Celtics
items.summary: After reinforcing his career​ accolades earlier in the day on social media, Golden State Warriors forward Draymond Green closed out an 88-87 win over the Boston Celtics on Sunday with a last-second defensive stop and rousing celebration from the veteran.
items.author: Anthony Slater

items.title: Which NBA players have the most triple-doubles of all time?
items.summary: Russell Westbrook holds the NBA record for most triple-doubles in a career. See who else joins him on the list.
items.author: Keith Jenkins

items.title: Karl-Anthony Towns has 30 points and 13 rebounds as Knicks beat Pacers 113-106
items.summary: Karl-Anthony Towns had 30 points and 13 rebounds, Jalen Brunson added 22 points, and the New York Knicks beat the Indiana Pacers 113-106 on Sunday night to extend their winning streak to five games.

items.title: Jokic's triple-double, Murray's 45 points lead Nuggets to 151-145 overtime win over Bulls
items.summary: Nikola Jokic had 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists for the 202nd triple double of his career, Jamal Murray scored eight of his season-high 45 points in overtime, and the Denver Nuggets held off the Chicago Bulls 151-145 on Sunday night.

items.title: Cooper Flagg saves Mavericks with late free throws to hold off Jazz comeback in 116-114 win
items.summary: Cooper Flagg scored 28 points and made the game-winning free throws with 3.7 seconds left to lift the Dallas Mavericks over the Utah Jazz 116-114 after they squandered an 18-point lead in the fourth quarter on Sunday night.

items.title: Klay Thompson blows out shoe in Heat's win over Thunder
items.summary: Klay Thompson blew out part of a shoe while defending a fast break in the Heat's game against the Thunder on Sunday night.

items.title: Bam Adebayo's triple-double ignites Heat's 123-113 victory over Thunder
items.summary: In a game that did not feature Oklahoma City's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander or Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo swiped the spotlight, scoring 24 points en route to a triple-double, as the surging Heat defeated the Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night.

items.title: Wizards rout the Magic 116-96 to win their 3rd straight following an 8-game skid
items.summary: Kyshawn George scored 24 points and Anthony Davis added 22 to lead the Washington Wizards to their third straight victory, 116-96 over the Orlando Magic on Sunday night.

items.title: Adebayo gets triple-double, Heat (without Giannis) top Thunder (without SGA) for 7th straight win
items.summary: Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and had a triple-double, Pelle Larsson scored 21 and the shorthanded Miami Heat beat the very shorthanded Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night to push their winning streak to seven games.

items.title: Bulls G Norman Powell sidelined by mild hamstring injury
items.summary: Bulls guard Norman Powell was ruled out against the Nuggets and will be reevaluated later in the week because of a mild right hamstring strain.

items.title: Alexander-Walker has 27 points as Hawks roll to 107-97 win over Pistons in off game for Cunningham
items.summary: Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 27 points, Atlanta opened the fourth quarter with an 18-0 run, and the Hawks beat the Detroit Pistons 107-97 on Sunday as Cade Cunningham was held to a season-low five points.

items.title: Sources: Free agent Gabe Vincent, Kings finalizing deal
items.summary: Gabe Vincent is finalizing a deal with the Kings to fill their 15th roster spot, league sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
items.author: Anthony Slater

image.credit: David L. Nemec/NBAE via Getty Images

items.title: Mikal Bridges shakes off slump, hits buzzer-beater to save Knicks vs. Blazers
items.summary: Mired in a shooting slump, Mikal Bridges delivered a buzzer-beating 3-pointer to lift the Knicks past the Trail Blazers after they squandered a 26-point lead.
items.author: Vincent Goodwill

items.title: Wembanyama makes history in 18 minutes, finishes game with 50 points
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama had his third career 50-point outing during a win over the Pelicans to go along with 19 rebounds, five blocks and four steals.
items.author: Michael C. Wright

items.title: Murray's putback with 5 seconds left lifts Kings to 97-96 win over Celtics, ending 8-game skid
items.summary: Keegan Murray's putback over three defenders with 5 seconds left lifted the Sacramento Kings to a 97-96 victory over the Boston Celtics on Saturday night.

items.title: Kyrie Irving scores 25, Cooper Flagg 22 as the Mavericks top the Clippers 110-100
items.summary: Kyrie Irving scored 25 points and Cooper Flagg had 22 points, eight rebounds and six assists as the Dallas Mavericks used a late 11-0 run to beat the Los Angeles Clippers 110-100 on Saturday night.

items.title: Victor Wembanyama has 50 points, 19 rebounds on dominant night as Spurs roll past Pelicans, 114-91
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama had 50 points, with 32 coming in the first half, along with 19 rebounds, five blocks and four steals and the San Antonio Spurs rolled to a 114-91 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Saturday.
items.matchup: New Orleans Pelicans @ San Antonio Spurs

items.title: Brunson scores 30, Bridges hits 3 at buzzer, lifting Knicks to 97-96 win over Trail Blazers
items.summary: Jalen Brunson scored 30 points, Mikel Bridges hit the winning 3-pointer at the buzzer, and the New York Knicks edged the Portland Trail Blazers 97-96 on Saturday night.
items.matchup: Portland Trail Blazers @ New York Knicks

items.title: Jaden McDaniels scores 25 and Timberwolves top short-handed Grizzlies 104-95
items.summary: Jaden McDaniels scored 25 points, Ayo Dosunmu added 19 and the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the short-handed Memphis Grizzlies 104-95 on Saturday night.

items.title: 76ers survive in clutch again despite Herro's 50: 'Got to finish better'
items.summary: The 76ers survived 50 points from Tyler Herro, nearly blowing a 10-point lead late, before once again coming out on top in the clutch.
items.author: Kris Rhim

items.title: Joel Embiid, LeBron James lead Eastern Conference-leading 76ers past the Bucks 132-129
items.summary: Joel Embiid had 26 points and 17 rebounds, LeBron James scored 13 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter and the Eastern Conference-leading Philadelphia 76ers held on for a 132-129 victory over Tyler Herro and the last-place Milwaukee Bucks on...

items.title: 76ers' Jaylen Brown, Dean Wade out, Tyrese Maxey starting vs. Bucks
items.summary: 76ers forwards Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade will miss Saturday's game against the Bucks with left hamstring injuries, their second straight game out.
items.author: Kris Rhim

items.title: Lakers rally after JJ Redick rips team's lack of fight vs. last-place Kings
items.summary: Lakers coach JJ Redick ripped into the team's lack of fight after trailing the last-place Kings at halftime, and Los Angeles went on to eke out a 106-104 win.
items.author: Dave McMenamin

items.title: Ime Udoka frustrated by Rockets' defense: 'No effort or any attention to detail'
items.summary: Coach Ime Udoka was upset by the Rockets' lack of physicality and effort as they gave up a season high in points during a loss to the Nuggets, calling the defense "as bad as I've seen it."

items.title: Scottie Barnes scores 29, including key layup, as Raptors end skid with 105-102 win over Pistons
items.summary: Scottie Barnes scored 29 points, including a layup with 14 seconds left, and the Toronto Raptors ended their six-game losing streak with a 105-102 win over the Detroit Pistons in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.

items.title: 2026 NBA Cup: Schedule, format, groups, updates and more
items.summary: Here's everything you need to know about the fourth annual in-season tournament, including the recent win by the Nuggets.

items.title: Nikola Jokic's big 2nd half sends the Nuggets to a 133-124 win over the Rockets
items.summary: Nikola Jokic had 26 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds as the Denver Nuggets defeated the Houston Rockets 133-124 in a back-and-forth NBA Cup game Friday night.

items.title: Luka Doncic scores 25, Lakers barely hold off Kings 106-104 on LaVine's miss at the buzzer
items.summary: Luka Doncic had 25 points and eight assists, Quentin Grimes hit a tiebreaking 3-pointer with 57 seconds to play, and the Los Angeles Lakers rallied in the fourth quarter for their 10th win in 11 games, 106-104 over the Sacramento Kings on Friday night.

items.title: Devin Booker scores 23 points and Suns pull away in final minute for 111-101 win over Jazz
items.summary: Devin Booker had 23 points and the Phoenix Suns scored the final six of the game to pull away late and beat the Utah Jazz 111-101 in an NBA Cup matchup Friday night.

items.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 40 as Thunder beat Pelicans 126-120 in NBA Cup
items.summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40 points and the Oklahoma City Thunder rallied in the fourth quarter for a 126-120 win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Friday night to improve to 2-1 in NBA Cup play.
items.matchup: New Orleans Pelicans @ Oklahoma City Thunder
